summary: International Seaways (parent) filed an 8-K disclosing Exchange and Support Agreements and a Transaction Agreement with Bruton Limited, a Bermuda company whose NDRs trade in Norway. Holders representing ~50.5% of Bruton common agreed to exchange each Bruton share for 0.05190 INSW shares privately, expected to close on or about October 20, 2026; Merger Sub then merges into Bruton, making Bruton an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. Terms are stock-for-stock with cash in lieu of fractional shares; no price, premium, or advisor stated. The lock-up support secures merger approval. What to watch: Bruton shareholder vote and remaining minority roll-up.
